verification_notes: Grupo Renfe published on 2026-09-02 that the consolidated group result for 2025 was a net profit of 60.2 million euros, versus a loss of 2.9 million in 2024.
The official Renfe publication supports the 2025 revenue, ticket-sales revenue, EBITDA, passenger-volume and subsidiary-result figures used in the article.
The article correctly distinguishes consolidated group profit from the results of individual businesses and does not infer that every Renfe activity was profitable.
The March 2026 Renfe publication described the accounts as pending audit; the September 2026 publication reports the final 60.2 million euro result.
No certification is granted because explicit human editorial approval and a publication-gate decision are still required.
